preconditions.description: The length of the string S must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz?' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must only contain lowercase English letters or '?'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum ascii sum of the absolute difference of adjacent characters if S can be made a palindrome, otherwise -1.
The result must be a non-negative integer or -1 if it is not possible to make S a palindrome.
